_comment: Critical journey for the slop-landing fixture: a choir director comparing plans on the landing page.
title: Compare the plans for a choir

persona.group: Volunteer choir directors and choir secretaries looking for a scheduling tool
knows: how many singers and sections their choir has
roughly what the choir can afford each month
persona.context: On a laptop after a rehearsal, comparing a few tools before the committee meeting

goal: Find out what it would cost the choir and what each price includes
scenario: Your community choir has 40 singers in four sections. The committee asked you to find out what this scheduling tool would cost each month and what you get for that. Find the prices.
